question: In what form is the vital principle present within all living beings?
premises: This air is present in all beings
Its presence is established within them
inference: Therefore the vital air abides as a wind-filled presence in all living beings.
uncertainties: Agreement of saṃsthitam with vāyuḥ is syntactically loose in this form.
plain_english: As the wind-filled vital air, it is situated in all living beings.
